name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    # 09:00 Beijing time (UTC+8) is 01:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  post-coffee-lottery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Build Coffee Bot
        run: |
          # Assuming the bot is a Java application, build it here
          # Adjust the command based on your build tool (Maven/Gradle)
          if [ -f "pom.xml" ]; then
            mvn clean package -DskipTests
          elif [ -f "build.gradle" ]; then
            ./gradlew build -x test
          fi

      - name: Run Coffee Bot to Post Lottery
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # Add any other required secrets for MCP access or API keys
          MCP_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MCP_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          # Execute the bot to create the post
          # Adjust the class name or script path as needed
          java -jar target/coffee-bot-1.0.jar post-lottery
